bayts.text: Glad tidings for us! Generosity and munificence have come to us, as the sacred months dawned upon us.
We have attained repentance (accepted) with forgiveness in Rajab, and we hope, in the remaining (months), for the taming of those who have been deprived (of grace).
We hope from the One, the Subduer (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), our Creator, the subduing of the enemies: He is Compeller and Avenger.
He is the Succourer (Al-Mughīth), Whose succour I hope for, and I take no vengeance for myself in the two Abodes.
He is the Wise (Al-Ḥakīm): what He wills is, and what He does not will remains forever non-existent.
To Him (belong) the creatures, to Him their deeds, and to Him — sublime is He — Existence, which beginningless Eternity has adorned.
Whoever ascribes to Him — sublime is He — forever a son, making a trinity, his foot has slipped therein.
Repent to Him, O people of the Trinity, in haste, and hurry before death, after which (there is only) regret.
Hasten to your Lord, submitting all together, following him (the Prophet) from whose party the darkness has been removed.
Allah is Everlasting, Ancient, He does not resemble what crosses the mind: He is the Unique, the Distinguished.
And whoever makes a trinity of One Unique, King, Self-Sufficient, is ignorant, and shall meet all the pain.
You are bewildered, captives of the Accursed (Satan), all together, deaf and blind, and likewise in the tongues is dumbness (Qurʾān 2:18).
Truly I praise a Lord Who has no partner, on land and on sea: He is the All-Embracing, the Judge.
I call upon Him, and He is Generous, He does not disappoint me, since through Him, from Him, wisdoms come to my heart.
He is the One Whose being for me today has gladdened me, and from my heart doubt and anguish have vanished.
Would that my people, on this day, knew of His being for me (Qurʾān 36:26), when the minor faults were effaced from me.
He has been for me, and to Him are my gratitude and my praise; to Him my heart, the body and the pen.
To Him is my gratitude, with a Qurʾān I chant, from my (present) hour until my raising up, and He is a banquet for me.
It is the Book: whoever has been its servant, knowledge, deeds and character have been purified for him.
And truly I worship the Lord through it forever, servant of an Intercessor whose gifts are continuous rains.
He is the generous one (the Prophet), through whose service I hope for what surpasses what Harim led to Zuhayr.
I hope, through his service, to be here and tomorrow with the Foremost (Muḥammad), like the Companions, those who were noble.
May (Allah) bless him with peace, together with those who are with him; and He has been for me, and through him He has tamed for me those who were deprived (of grace).
And He has driven to me all that I desire, without asking, with a driving through which generosity and munificence become manifest.
As long as my Lord endures, and the Chosen One endures (as) my refuge, with glad tidings the sacred months shall come.
